title: Search economy code retrieval Q1 enriched single shot and Q2 agentic DAG arm results evidence chunk 4
summary: context layer is task-DAG-centric (selects related TASK nodes; contextDependencyFromResult does not even carry file/start/end). Plain broad /search surfaces code_nodes fine (that IS Q1); the agentic wrapper's task-self-match + no code tierBoost is what blocks the code tier from selection. Conclusion: iterative/DAG retrieval cannot convert single-shot code-nav misses as currently wired — the win is the enriched single-shot path, not the agentic/DAG path.
